steps.text: In one or two more branches' time, the color of dusk will paint the sky.
These are the Three Mounts and Seventeen Peaks, though which mount this is, or which peak, is a mystery.
The only thing known is that a pavilion sits atop, Shangshu's scenery both past and present visible from within, beauty unparalleled.
Yet regrettably, this pavilion is currently deserted, and so no one is there to see it.
And on that note, people have come.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Well, here's the place.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What? That depressed about meeting her?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: She gets on my nerves.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: She's not gonna bug you.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: That's why she gets on my nerves.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: ...*Sigh*.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: She's our big sister either way. Let's straighten up.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: She's not even here.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Nope, she isn't. Why not?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: With all the fuss down below... taking cover up here in the ranges does kind of smell like her style.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: How come when I hide you call me a recluse, but when she does it you're like this?!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Hey... it's not like she's always trying to hide.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: She's just tipsy and worn out, looking for a nice crag splitting the drifting clouds to lie down on, knocking out for a moment. That's not so bad.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Grr. This is discrimination.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Pull the other one.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I just hope she doesn't cause any trouble for us.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: She's always half-drunk, half-asleep, half-awake. It's those people who'll come give us trouble.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Yeah, real nice how she can sleep through this. Is she even able to?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Say, what'cha think she dreams of?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I don't know. Don't ask me.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Heaven knows where her mind wanders. She'll come back on her own once she's bored, in any case.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I hear this peak's apparently meant to be wrecked.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Wonder how hard Kroos and the Nothing guy'll have to work finding this summit at all.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Sir, what do you have there?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: What comes will come, trouble and all.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: You bumped into Shang?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Yes. He stole the cup.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: That bastard! How does one man be so single-minded—!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Leave it. This whole thing is a mess.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Heh, good swords always keep the rust away.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Been years since I saw you draw it, sir.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Blades are ruthless things. Best put to use slicing melons and chopping greens.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: But if I want my business handed smoothly over to my darling Ye, then I have to settle things with Shang Zhong eventually.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Old Shang might be muddled in the head, but he's not the good-for-nothing who'd harass the Miss about paying her father's debts.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Sir, you still won't step over that final line, will you?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: What kind of person could?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: One storm, two lives. It was my mistake that let his son die. He has a grudge against me I can't argue with.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: I know more than anyone how he's felt all these years.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Sir...

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Relax. I'll get the cup back, at the very least.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: If I don't, I won't have anything to report.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Master Shen—isn't there any way to get up the mountains a little quicker?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: In a sense, but for people who've never taken the mountain passes before, it might be...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You're fine, I'm used to this.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Alright, then. This way.

steps.name: Waregeist
steps.text: Ao—!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Gah. What's the deal with these things?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Hey! Lee!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: I'm fighting for you here! Is this any place to space out?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: ...I'm fine.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Pull it together. I don't know why these things keep mobbing us, and we've lost the Blacknight lady and the pole-carrier by now.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Why aren't you, I don't know, hurrying it up?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: No rush, now, no rush.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: When I accept a friend's request, I see it through. It's just...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: We need to find a favorable pavilion near very favorable water for it.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Huff...

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: (At such a young age, her agility is nearly unimaginable...)

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Such a steep pass, and you're not even gasping for air yet.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Have you been crossing mountains all your life?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Only got into the habit the last couple of years...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: And I'm Rim Billiton-born. Might not be quite the Yan style, but it's a life on the wilder side anyhow.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: The passes around these summits are all hard to traverse. They always said in olden times that Shu's paths tried you. People argue which ones that meant, but it's all of them, in truth.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Master Shen, you think there's a reason Mr. Lee told us to find him at Qujiang Peak?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: When he was looking into the goblet's origins for Mr. Liang, the first place he said he'd head for was Qujiang Peak.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: And he asked for 'Zuanjiang Peak.' Only a few locals know that old name; the authorities changed it however many years ago. I was baffled how he even knew it.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Maybe Mr. Lee found some kind of lead on it...

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: He did have a lead. He said, he dreamt of it.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: I assumed he was hiding something, using that reason to parry me, so I didn't follow up... If he really did see it in his dreams, then that's all more curious.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Hmm... Qujiang Peak is a high and treacherous one. It gets the least tourists. It's all the more peaceful here, compared to the well-inhabited Nini Peak with its gentle flat paths, or Shuzhou Peak covered with old theater byways.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: You've seen... the few small villages, buildings left, are all left over from long, long ago.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Though...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Is there some other hint?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Though... when Qujiang Peak was still called Zuanjiang Peak, atop this region of mountain, there was actually another peak.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: It and Zuanjiang together were called the 'Twin Peaks High as the Sun,' the two most majestic prominences of the Three Mounts and Eighteen Peaks.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: And this peak had countless cliffs, the steepest parts almost vertical, like a stone sword against the heavens when you looked from afar. It was a magnificent sight.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: If you watched from any other peak at sunset, it was as if the sun fell straight on it, as if someone ran it through by their blade.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Sadly, later there was a massive Catastrophe, like fire and storm linking hands, and the terrain around here was scarred well. Most of that swordlike peak collapsed and crumbled. That was thirty years ago, now.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: You can pull aside any Shangshuite on the street of at least some age, and they could all tell you clear and cleanly of the marvel of those black clouds weighing on the city.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: I regret I wasn't eking my living on this river yet then. I never got to see it with my own eyes.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: A Catastrophe... And Shangshuites'd call it a marvel?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: It's a strange thing. It came without the slightest warning. By the time the Imperial Astronomers got the warning out telling the villages nearby to evacuate, it was already barely manageable. There should've been no escape from it...

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: But ultimately, thunder clapped and the storm faded, and apart from a few lightly battered houses, all the residences in the mountains suffered not a single bit of damage, and not one person was afflicted. That was the first wonder.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Afterwards, the Tumu tianshi came to inspect the altered mountain terrain. Normally, with a wondrous peak collapsing like that, there should be visible traces left.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: But apart from half of the rocky 'hilt' left next to Qujiang Peak, not a single chunk of boulder or sign of the landslide was found. That was the second wonder.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: What caused any of that, nobody knows. There's just some wild rumors, barely worth trusting.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Never thought something like that happened in Shangshu before...

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Yan's history and its legends have always blended together.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Like how some rumors say Shangshu's birth was to do with the lands in ancient people's dreams. The factual matter of things is beyond anyone's research powers, now.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: The peak that disappeared—what was its name?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: The sunseeker. Xunri Peak.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: But Yan's development has flown by. I fear to the younger generation, things that happened thirty years ago wouldn't be worth the time, being so far in the past.

steps.name: Uphill Voice
steps.text: Stay still—!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: —Who's that?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) Stone the flamin' fowlbeasts!- Light, keep it from buggering off!

steps.name: Waregeist
steps.text: Wrrrr—! Aoww—!

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) You just—settle down, love—!

steps.name: Waregeist
steps.text: —Wwrr!

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Is she... trying to catch that thing?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Seems like it...

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) Crikey, just like that, keep it bound tight, eyes glued to it!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) You a Rim Billy, then?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) Now, quit muckin' about... we're only...

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) Ya wouldn't be Yanese just lookin' at ya.

steps.name: Waregeist
steps.text: Aoww—!

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) —Oi help us out. Hrgh! Hey take a squiz at this and lemme know what kinda animal this is?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) It's... some Originium Arts creation-type.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) Originium Arts? Like those stunts the Leithanian lord boys pull? You revvin my cylinder? Had me thinkin' it was some Yan critter I could tame...

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) Which galah went and made these things up...?! Light! Just let it go, it's as useful as an ashtray on a bike!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) We're looking for their owner, too. Whadyareckon?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) I...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) You a Messenger's guard? Bounty hunter?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) No sense in shootin' a hound if it's gone into the neighbors paddock, wanna work together on this?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) I don't know you from Bruce, mate, so don't think I'm gonna trust ya

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) A Billy, though.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) Not every one of them's so nice.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) That's a dead shame, then...

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) But getting to meet a Billitonian out here's still got me gobsmacked

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) Hooroo. See you round like a boomerang, Cautus.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Your countryman?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Suppose so... can't shake this dodgy feeling...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Ah, whatever. How far left to the summit, Master Shen?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: A road this wide, and you two can't move aside?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Tough.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: What does a mandarin want with me?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Master Shang. Do you have any idea what that thing on your belt is?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Is it yours?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Yes and no, but we hope you'll hand it to us.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: How do you know me?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: We've heard some rumors.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Hoh. What did Zheng Qingyue tell you?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: If your first reaction is to think of Sir Zheng, then presumably you know where we came from?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: The Sui Regulator's Candleholders.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: But you're so young... You're one I've never met before.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: If you're aware of our rank, why don't you give up the cup?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Me and Zheng Qingyue need to settle things.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But it seems like those things and the item at your waist are unrelated.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: My son died for this goblet. How could I be unrelated?

steps.name: Waregeist
steps.text: Wrwwrr...

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Fine ability, for one so young. These animals almost seem to fear you.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: We ask only your cooperation.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: What if I say no? Will you rob me in the open?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I imagine you'll find absolutely no purpose in this cup.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But to we of the Sui Regulator, the cup has tremendous use.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: What use?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Bait.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: For what?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Those who bring ruin to the nation and its people.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Yan has known peace for centuries. Where did criminals like those come from?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: That's need-to-know.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: However, we ask you to believe us. Entrust the goblet to us, and you'll have done a justice great as the heavens.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Hah! A justice... For someone of my sort, it'd mean too little, and be more than I deserve.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Move aside.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I fear that's not for you to decide, Master Shang.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: This goblet is to be buried with my son. Zheng Qingyue must come in person...

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Otherwise, keep shut!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I'll wait for him, at the Field of Forgotten Water on Qujiang Peak!

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Ingrate!

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: —A staff fighter?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Oh—good, strong might. You have some force, old bull.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Lord Zuo, this man hides his talents. No good lies in him.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Get the goods before anything! Don't let him keep you!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Did you ever hear from Zheng Qingyue the words I hate most?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Don't fool with us!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: —They're 'save the goods, then the men.'
